facts.fact: WURI-Niger's Component 3 (World Bank financing of about USD 81 million, in force 19 August 2021) funds an interoperability and secure data exchange framework between the base ID system and public and private service providers' systems; no platform in service is stated.

facts.fact: WURI-Niger's Component 3 funds the commissioning of an interoperability framework to offer identity verification and authentication services to public and private service providers; banks, telecom operators, money transfer firms, social protection, tax and social security bodies are named as direct beneficiaries, with no service stated as in use.
